frequency_question: How often do Treasury debt management interventions successfully ramp up operational volumes to target thresholds within scheduled timelines?
membership_rule: Includes major U.S. Treasury issuance or buyback structural adjustments involving phased implementation; excludes emergency ad-hoc liquidity facilities.
coverage_note: 4 named major operational scaling cycles; covers modern intervention programs.
known_gaps: Limited sample size due to infrequency of large-scale structural debt management shifts.
skeleton: four historical debt intervention scaling cycles since 2008, of which three successfully reached full operational volume targets within schedule.
validity_reason: Based on structural institutional processes within the U.S. Treasury that evolve slowly over decades.
